regionDiff.note: mark + label region (0,0,200,56) excludes the value, whose fixture data ($12,345.67) deliberately differs from the frame's presentation value ($12.34). This number isolates design drift from data.

residualReasons: F1 label typography: the shipped ItemTitle is 14px/500/19.25 where the frame draws 16px/400/20; every label glyph differs (dominant contributor).
F2 value weight: 500 vs 600 changes stem width on every digit.
F3 2px gap and content offset shift the label one pixel column and the media-to-label spacing by 2px.
Fixture data: the story renders $12,345.67 because the frame's $12.34 is presentation data (audit.md §5), so the value region cannot match by design.

Platform rasterisation: Figma rasterises SF Pro Text with its own renderer; the capture rasterises the macOS system stack in Chromium. Glyph edges differ pixel by pixel even where the design matches (visible as yellow tolerance pixels in the heatmap and as the small mark-edge cluster).
